description: Frontend Part E — vanilla-JS SPA wiring in frontend/app.js, frontend/index.html, frontend/style.css for all Phase-1 features: max-price+currency listing field, collector quote submission (gated by /collector/me), owner multi-quote review + Confirm-deal flow with the unlock point strictly server-driven, new status badges + CSS, cancel/dispute buttons placed by stage, 'Become a collector' Profile form + document upload, and the admin-only #/admin/collectors route. Depends on FEAT-002/FEAT-003 (the backend routes/views it calls). Do NOT touch the Future Actions tab. No framework, no build step.
steps: Listing form: in frontend/index.html reportForm add after rfArea: rfMaxPrice (number, step 0.01, min 0, label 'Maximum price you'll pay (optional)') and rfCurrency (select, default MYR; MYR/SGD/USD). In frontend/app.js report submit handler add priceType:'user_pays', currency, and maxPrice (only if non-empty) to the POST body; if maxPrice present it must parse to a number > 0 else show the existing reportError.

Collector quote submission: on a Type B portal listing card make the primary action 'Submit Quote' opening a small overlay with an amount input (hint 'Owner's max: {maxPrice} {currency}' when set) + optional message -> collectFetch('POST', {wasteId, quoteAmount, message}, 'request'). 403 -> 'You need to be a verified collector to quote — apply from your Profile.'; 400/409 -> surface the server error text verbatim (including the 'no longer available' 409). Gate the quote UI with GET /collector/me: non-approved users see the apply CTA instead of the amount form.

Owner multi-quote review: add renderIncomingQuotesForWaste(wasteId) that filters lifecycleRequests.incoming to cr.wasteId===wasteId && cr.role==='owner', sorts by quoteAmount asc, and renders one card per quote into #notifDetail (collectorName, quoteAmount+currency, maxPrice, message via escapeHtml, statusBadge). Per-card actions: requested->Accept data-approve; accepted->Confirm deal data-confirm + Cancel data-cancel; cr.unlocked===true->View details data-open; terminal (rejected/closed/cancelled)->status only. Call wireNotifDetailActions() once after building. Change openRequestInNotifications(wasteId) to call renderIncomingQuotesForWaste(wasteId) once lifecycleRequests is populated (keep the existing retry/setTimeout loop).

showNotifDetailForCollectRequest: add branch 'else if (cr && cr.role==="owner" && cr.status==="accepted")' -> Confirm deal (data-confirm) + Cancel (data-cancel), copy 'You picked this quote. Confirm to share your address and open chat.', NO address/phone shown. Change the unlock branch condition from cr.status==='approved' to (cr && cr.unlocked===true) (equiv ['confirmed','collected','disputed'].indexOf(cr.status)!==-1); body unchanged (address/phone/pickup/notes + Open Chat + Mark as Collected) plus Report a problem (data-dispute) for confirmed/collected and Cancel job (data-cancel) for the owner on a confirmed job.

wireNotifDetailActions: add handlers reusing act(suffix,id,btn) — [data-confirm]->act('confirm',id,btn), [data-cancel]->act('cancel',id,btn), [data-dispute]->open a reason box then collectFetch('POST', {collectRequestId:id, reason}, 'dispute'), [data-open]->showNotifDetailForCollectRequest(findCollectRequest(id)). The frontend never infers unlock from anything but the server's cr.unlocked/status.

statusBadge: extend the label map with accepted:'Accepted', confirmed:'Confirmed', cancelled:'Cancelled', closed:'Not selected', disputed:'Disputed'. In frontend/style.css add .status-accepted/.status-confirmed/.status-cancelled/.status-closed/.status-disputed (confirmed/collected green-ish; cancelled/closed grey; disputed/rejected red). Reflect new statuses as terminal cards in History/Notifications (no further actions on cancelled/closed/rejected).

fmtTime guard: ensure only the new epoch-seconds fields (confirmedAt/disputedAt/cancelledAt/verifiedAt/collectors createdAt/updatedAt) are passed to fmtTime; any collect-request/message createdAt (microseconds) rendered near a new field must be divided by 1e6 first. Keep Phase-1 UI rendering only safe seconds fields.

'Become a collector' on Profile: in frontend/index.html add a Profile 'Collector account' section; in app.js show a 'Become a collector' button when GET /collector/me returns status:'none', else a status display (draft/pending/approved/rejected/suspended + rejectionReason). Apply/submit form: business name, registration number, waste-carrier license, service areas, waste categories, contact phone/email, plus a document-upload row per docType. Upload flow: POST /collector/upload-url passing the file MIME as contentType -> presigned PUT -> fetch(url,{method:'PUT',headers:{'Content-Type':file.type},body:file}) directly to S3 (NO bearer header; Content-Type must match the presign). Then POST /collector/apply -> POST /collector/submit; show the returned status.

Admin route: patch BOTH return paths of Auth.profile() to add groups — live-session branch groups: payload['cognito:groups']||[]; localStorage branch groups: claims['cognito:groups']||[]. Add ROUTES entry 'admin': { view:'adminOverlay', gated:true, enter:onEnterAdmin } and an 'Admin' nav entry shown only when (Auth.profile().groups||[]).indexOf('admins')!==-1. Add the adminOverlay section to index.html. onEnterAdmin calls GET /admin/collectors?status=pending, renders queue cards (business name, numbers, service areas, document View links using the returned presigned GET URLs) with Approve / Reject (reason) / Suspend buttons wired to the admin POST routes, then refreshes. This gate is convenience only — the server re-verifies via _is_admin.
Do NOT modify renderFurtherActions or the Future Actions tab / flowchart / cards.
acceptance_criteria: node --check frontend/app.js reports no syntax errors.
The listing form shows max-price + currency and a priced listing POSTs priceType/currency/maxPrice; the quote overlay gates on /collector/me and surfaces 403/400/409 server messages.
After Accept the UI shows NO address/phone; only after Confirm deal does cr.unlocked===true render the unlock card — the unlock point is server-driven.
statusBadge renders accepted/confirmed/cancelled/closed/disputed with matching CSS; cancel/dispute buttons appear by stage and never delete client-side.

The Profile collector form drives apply->submit and document upload via presigned PUT; the Admin nav + #/admin/collectors appear only when the ID token's cognito:groups contains 'admins' (both Auth.profile() paths patched).
The Future Actions tab is unchanged.
verification: From the worktree root run 'node --check frontend/app.js' and confirm there are no syntax errors.

Grep frontend/app.js to confirm the new functions/handlers exist (renderIncomingQuotesForWaste, data-confirm/data-cancel/data-dispute/data-open wiring, the accepted branch, the cr.unlocked unlock condition, Auth.profile groups on both paths) and that renderFurtherActions was not modified.
From the worktree root run 'pytest -q' to confirm backend tests still pass (frontend edits must not touch backend).
findings:
Implemented all Part E wiring in frontend/app.js, index.html, style.css. Verified: 'node --check frontend/app.js' clean; 'pytest -q' 44 passed; renderFurtherActions / Future Actions tab untouched (git diff shows no renderFurtherActions lines).

INTEGRATION NOTES for backend route shapes the frontend now calls (per FEAT-003 findings):
- Listing POST 'report' now sends priceType:'user_pays', currency (MYR/SGD/USD), and maxPrice (number>0) only when the optional field is filled. Backend must accept/ignore these on the waste report.
- Collector quote: non-owner viewer of an open/requested listing POSTs {wasteId, quoteAmount, message} to 'request' (reusing the collect endpoint). Gated client-side by GET /collector/me returning status==='approved' (apply CTA otherwise). The quote form expects per-waste multi-quote: owner-side lifecycleRequests.incoming items must carry quoteAmount, currency, maxPrice, message, collectorName, and role==='owner' + wasteId for renderIncomingQuotesForWaste to group/sort them.
- Unlock is STRICTLY server-driven: the frontend reads cr.unlocked (true only for confirmed/collected/disputed per UNLOCK_STATUSES) and never infers it. Owner 'accepted' shows Confirm deal + Cancel with NO address/phone. After Confirm, cr.unlocked===true renders address/phone (collector role) + Open Chat + Mark as Collected, plus Report a problem (confirmed/collected) and owner Cancel job (confirmed).
- Lifecycle actions post {collectRequestId} to suffixes: approve, reject, done, confirm, cancel; dispute posts {collectRequestId, reason}. These must match the FEAT-003 endswith wiring (confirm/cancel/dispute).
- collectFetch now surfaces the server error body verbatim (JSON {error} or raw text) and attaches err.status, so 400/409 messages (incl. the 409 'no longer available') show as-is and 403 maps to the 'verified collector' prompt.
- Collector apply form: POST /collector/upload-url {docType in registration|license|insurance, contentType in image/png|image/jpeg|application/pdf} -> presigned PUT with EXACT Content-Type header, NO bearer -> then POST /collector/apply (business fields + comma-split serviceAreas/wasteCategories arrays) -> POST /collector/submit. Status surfaced from GET /collector/me (none/draft show the apply flow).
- Admin: Auth.profile() now returns groups (both the live-session and localStorage paths read cognito:groups). Admin nav button (#adminNavBtn) + #/admin/collectors route appear only when groups contains 'admins'. onEnterAdmin -> GET /admin/collectors?status=<pending|approved|rejected|suspended>; cards render docUrls (presigned GET) as View links and Approve/Reject(reason)/Suspend -> POST /admin/collectors/{id}/{action}. Server re-verifies via _is_admin.
- fmtTime still expects epoch seconds; added a >1e13 guard that divides microsecond-scale values by 1e6 as a safety net. Microsecond collect-request/message createdAt is not rendered via fmtTime near new seconds fields.

No real payment code added (Type B labelled only, '# Phase 2' intent). No client-side deletes: cancel/dispute are status POSTs only.
